result.reason: The affiliate and contractor coverage reaches part of the preferred position, and M&A-successor transferability reaches the fallback. However, section (c) still ends the licence whenever the Agreement terminates under section 12, potentially permitting termination on grounds other than an uncured material breach and conflicting with the new revocability language. The clause also does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or provide general transferability to successors. Adding correspondent broker customers exceeds the supplied playbook scope, and the conflict between the grant and term provisions reduces drafting quality.
